why: No major reviewer or authority shows up in the results. The only niche site that answers the van question with real data is powersized. It is untested and picks a power station without panels, so it doesn't actually answer the kit question. The rest are affiliate listicles whose testing claims can't be checked, or pages about RVs. Seven of the twelve results gave ChatGPT no text at all. A focused page on van solar kits with panels included, current prices and checked codes would stand out, much like our proven win.
